# Fresh independent PR16 UI/runtime review
Subject: ed84894946e28ec5c1c8c6fb6d4fd55edc6368fb against 5ea6f6d702487832b6c70157843c1bc7cbbbf67f.
INDEPENDENCE: FRESH. No source or repository-test changes. Isolated built Vite preview 127.0.0.1:4177; intercepted synthetic APIs. Installed Impeccable audit and Mika Red Team contract used. Owner cassette/brass deck brief preserved, not judged against reviewer taste.
Verdict: NOT_READY (new P2 accessibility defect).

## New blocking finding
PR16-DARK-NAV-CONTRAST, P2, WCAG AA 1.4.3 and stated light/dark contrast requirement.
Files: src/client/styles/app.css:2444 (selected nav background --key-hover / foreground --key-ink); dark tokens at 2216, 2218 and explicit-night duplicate at 2229, 2231. Navigation font size 13px weight600 at 320.
Reproduce: open / at 390x844 with prefers-color-scheme dark. Inspect .tabbar a[aria-current=page]. Foreground rgb(251,239,217) (#fbefd9), background rgb(138,108,74) (#8a6c4a). WCAG luminance contrast 4.266419920257118:1; requires4.5:1 for13px/600 normal text. This is the primary selected navigation label, visible every journey; same active rule applies to each selected tab and desktop. Capture /tmp/pr16-state-dark-normal.png; measured /tmp/pr16-ui-states.json. Change token or selected-state pairing while retaining key/pressed state and ensure all nav/hovers pass both automatic dark and explicit-night, phone/desktop.
Decorative .cassette__name detector contrast outputs were discarded: decorative aria-hidden SVG with painted paper background is not represented by transparent DOM ancestor traversal. No decorative-label finding.

## Runtime evidence
node /tmp/pr16-ui.cjs: 44 screenshots / 11 routes x phone390x844 and desktop1440 x light/dark, long station/song/artist content. Routes /,/sender,/sender/1,/mehr,/verlauf,/import,/geraete,/fernbedienung,/info,/sender/neu,/suchlauf. No horizontal overflow, unlabeled input/select, outside viewport interactive control or JavaScript error. Actual capture inspection performed.
200% text size home: no horizontal overflow in light/dark (/tmp/pr16-light-zoom.png, /tmp/pr16-dark-zoom.png).
Navigation: route change moves focus to new route h1 (Deine Kassetten), verified tabindex=-1 focused.
node /tmp/pr16-ui-states.cjs: guest, native, pending, signed-out and denied-localStorage state renders in light/dark; no JavaScript errors. With localStorage getter throwing SecurityError, explicit Dunkel sets root data-illumination=night and checked radio remainstrue. Old FOUR-DESIGN-STORAGE behavior no longer reproduced. Sign-in CTA contrast meets threshold in both themes; old Klassik failure removed.
node /tmp/pr16-ui-actions.cjs: pending command says Start angefordert / Befehl wird gesendet and disables mainkey; refusal leaves1:37 stored and says Song remainsstored; native active mode accurately says device only plays one song, restarts at beginning and does not auto-advance. /tmp/pr16-ui-actions.json and screenshots. Offline event keeps snapshot visible with explicit offline warning.
Reducedmotion CSS gates reels and insertion animations behind no-preference (no global duration kill).
Bundled detector: node .agents/skills/impeccable/scripts/detect.mjs --json src/client. DEGRADED: HTML parser dependencies unavailable, regex fallback. Three border/key warnings express owner-pinned deck keys and are false positives; DESIGN token advisories reflect stale six-design doc, no functional defect inferred. Computed runtime contrast checked separately.

## Audit score
Accessibility3/4 (dark selected navigation contrast fails), performance3/4 (bounded local-clock/queue paths retained; no independent performance benchmark), responsive4/4 (matrix and200% text checked), theming3/4 (explicit/private switch works; dark nav contrast), implementationintegrity3/4 (coherent owner world, stale DESIGN sidecar/doc). Total16/20; score does not override blocking finding.

Physical iPhone, liveSpotify/provider latency/quota, private HA/MA integration, populated restore NOT_RUN. These captures are synthetic-state browser evidence, not live provider acceptance. Backend/session correctness reviewed separately by root/fresh functional reviewer; this verdict does not close PR15 regressions.
